description: This file contains the class PageRefFieldRenderer, responsible for rendering PageRefField objects to RTF format within the MigraDoc PDF generation library. It extends NumericFieldRendererBase and implements the rendering logic specific to page reference fields in RTF documents.

classes.name: PageRefFieldRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a PageRefField to RTF, inheriting from NumericFieldRendererBase.

methods.name: PageRefFieldRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializes the renderer with a DocumentObject and RtfDocumentRenderer, casting the document object to a PageRefField.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the PageRefField to RTF, writing the appropriate RTF control words and bookmark name.
